notes: Ball handling with four balls held in the trough (public 36-39, normalized so 1 = ball present) and the left ramp reported down (47). In attract: a ball on the outhole switch (35), then a ball in the shooter lane (43); then two coins (one credit at the factory default price) and Start. Each phase is separated by a quiet wait so its solenoid response is attributable. Stops at the first serve: the harness has no ball model, so later play is not meaningful.
